parameters.name: ArtifactId
parameters.description:
The artifact ID.

You can call the [ListArtifacts](~~469993~~) operation to obtain the artifact ID.

parameters.name: ArtifactVersion
parameters.description:
The artifact version.

You can call the [ListArtifacts](~~469993~~) operation to obtain the artifact version.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter.

Valid values:

- StartTime

- EndTime

- ApplicationGroupName

- ResouceName

- EventName

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to start the next paged query.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **Ascending**: sorts the results in ascending order.

- **Descending** (default): sorts the results in descending order.
